none: PAS NLM-C63755: Roman Coin: Nummus of Magnentius or Decentius
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [---]TIVS[--] ; R/ [VICT DD NN AVG ET CAES]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of Magnentius (350-353), copy of a two Victories issue of 351-353. The obverse bust, though very small, is heavy-jowled and probably a recognisable portrait. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Obverse inscription: [---]TIVS[--]. Reverse description: Two Victories holding up wreath. Reverse inscription: [VICT DD NN AVG ET CAES]. Diameter: 12.5mm, Weight: 1.01gms, die axis: probably 6
